verdict.rationale: Glama's registry lets developers search and inspect server capabilities and use an in-browser inspector that supports full MCP features (tools, resources, prompts, OAuth), and each listing provides pre-filled client configs (transport) for popular clients. However, there is no explicit evidence that listings show detailed input schemas or hosting attributes (e.g., where/how a server runs) prior to connecting - those docs mostly describe hosting configuration for servers you deploy yourself, not inspection of third-party listings. Missing for 10: explicit UI showing per-tool input schemas on server pages, and hosting/runtime attribute display for arbitrary registry listings before connection.
